---
title: "Flag Viewer"
format: html
resources:
  - "w2560/*.png"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
# Send the list of flag filenames in w2560/ to Observable JS
ojs_define(flag_files = list.files("w2560"))
```

```{ojs}
// Dropdown menu to choose a flag file
viewof selected_flag = Inputs.select(flag_files, {
  label: "Choose a flag:",
  value: "us.png"
})

// Display the selected flag image from the w2560 folder
html`<img src="w2560/${selected_flag}" style="max-width: 500px; border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: 1rem;">`
```
